entities.name: Thunder Thrash
entities.description: A criminal Viashino clan from Jund that came to Esper and gained etherium enhancements.

entities.name: Jkkhah
entities.description: The elder who led the Thunder Thrash's raid on the etherium storehouse.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of intellect where the thrash raided.

entities.name: Esper mages
entities.description: Esper forces that fought the thrash.

events.summary: The thrash's blood-raids take them to Esper, where they first succeed but lose numbers as mages adapt.
events.quote: The mages quickly adapted to their strength, however, and they started to lose many of their numbers.

events.summary: Jkkhah leads the thrash against a wartime etherium storehouse, overpowering its guardians.
events.quote: They overpowered the vedalken and homunculus guardians

events.summary: The thrash emerges with illicit etherium enhancements.
events.quote: the Thunder Thrash emerged with strange etherium enhancements

events.summary: The Thunderers fly and destroy the Esper strike force.
events.quote: The Esper strike force was quickly dispatched

relations.quote: The Esper strike force was quickly dispatched
